name: Aaron Drake: Ace Detective
source:
Aaron Drake: Ace Detective is a text-driven, deductive mystery visual novel developed and published by Fullmetal Typist.The story follows the analytical and precise detective Aaron Drake alongside his energetic rookie partner, Robin. Together, the duo must solve cases by breaking down witness testimonies and identifying contradictions. Unlike traditional investigative games, the title emphasizes pure logical deduction and lacks automated "detective vision" mechanics to highlight clues, forcing the player to rely entirely on their own observation and collected evidence to progress through interrogations.

Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4846250/Aaron_Drake_Ace_Detective/
